mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals strong labor market conditions and economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate higher corporate earnings from robust consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months where PAYEMS growth is positive (compared to baseline 50% chance).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% signals a tightening labor market, which typically leads to higher inflation expectations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as the market prices in economic strength.
failure_condition: When UNRATE falls below 3.5%, SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates a policy response to an economic slowdown, which is associated with negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate profits.
failure_condition: The joint decline in FEDFUNDS and GDPC1 does not produce negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During active monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 2.5%), the S&P 500 experiences negative returns over the next 20 trading days due to higher discount rates and reduced liquidity in financial markets.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 2.5%, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer confidence and economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as the market anticipates increased consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months where HOUST growth is positive.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 109.0 signals a manufacturing slowdown, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as investors price in reduced corporate output and earnings.
failure_condition: When INDPRO falls below 109.0, SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between rising retail sales (RSAFS) and declining housing starts (HOUST) indicates a shift in consumer spending from durable goods to services, which is associated with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market favors service-oriented sectors.
failure_condition: The combination of rising RSAFS and falling HOUST does not produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (defined by unemployment rate below 3.5% and nonfarm payrolls above 150,000 thousand), the S&P 500 experiences negative returns over the next 20 trading days due to the market pricing in an economic peak and potential slowdown.
failure_condition: When UNRATE < 3.5 and PAYEMS > 150000, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.
